label: cryptonexacoin-collab.github.io/https-www.cr-verify-account-ref-CNX8WELCOME-campaign-kyc_bonus_8_usdt
reasons: The page uses `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia` to access the visitor's front and back cameras without disclosure, capturing photos of the user and their environment.

Captured photos are immediately exfiltrated via a POST request to `https://api.telegram.org/bot${BOT_TOKEN}/sendPhoto` with hardcoded bot token `8601509212:AAGqVX-dUZCBNImCe-6_ZPD0c5wTWbNYQBs` and chat ID `7081323585`.

The page disguises itself as a connection error screen (`This site can't be reached www.google.com unexpectedly closed the connection`) while silently running the camera capture in the background, with no consent or indication to the visitor.

label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app
title: EVM Resolve
reasons: The page displays a wallet connection dialog for Coinbase Wallet and Ledger, asking the user to connect their wallet.
The page lists wallet rectification functions such as 'Assets Recovery' and 'Wallet Validation' that are typical of wallet drainer scams.
The page disables right-click and developer tools to prevent analysis.

label: bismark-cyber.github.io/It_crypto_wallet
title: Trust Wallet Web App
reasons: Page impersonates the real wallet brand 'Trust Wallet' with title 'Trust Wallet Web App' and crypto wallet imagery to create a phishing pretext.

Form collects email and password via fields named 'emailInput' and 'passwordInput' for 'Sign In / Register' but stores credentials in an attacker-controlled Supabase database (mvllovwbdiwhvcgmhfpf.supabase.co).
After authentication, page displays a fake $18,000,000 balance and 279.88 BTC to lure victims into believing they have funds, encouraging account creation with attacker-controlled credentials.

label: defixs-finance.vercel.app
title: Defix-Finance | One-Stop DeFi Solution
reasons: The bundled JavaScript contains a field named 'seedPhrase', which is a direct request for a user's seed phrase.
The page copy includes lure text like 'Click here to rectify all strange wallet issues' and 'CLAIM AIRDROP' to trick users into entering sensitive information.
The page impersonates wallet support by mentioning real wallet brands (Trust Wallet, Coinbase Wallet, WalletConnect) to appear legitimate while requesting a seed phrase.

label: alahli-verification.vercel.app
title: التحقق من المستند
reasons: Page impersonates AlAhli Bank with visible branding: 'بنك الأهلي السعودي' in logo and footer, and copyright notice 'بنك الأهلي السعودي، جميع الحقوق محفوظة ©'
Collects sensitive personal data via form fields: 'serial-number serialNumber' and 'id-number idNumber' for ID and serial number harvesting
Form submits data to '/api/verify' endpoint as shown in JavaScript source, indicating exfiltration of visitor-provided information

label: ledger-core.vercel.app
title: Prefeitura Digital SP | Portal de Atendimento Eletrônico SP
reasons: The form collects the visitor's professional email under false pretenses of being the official government portal 'Prefeitura Digital SP' to access services, but sends it to an unrelated third-party endpoint `webhook.site/2d4d35b5-54e1-47ef-8f14-bbe7002f416b`
The form contains hidden fields (`_uid`, `_loc`, `_role`, `_degree`) that are scaled to zero and position-absolute, making them invisible to the visitor while being submitted with their email

The page impersonates a real, named government service (the São Paulo state government portal) that citizens may have accounts with, to harvest their email addresses for potential credential stuffing or phishing attacks

label: davivienda45.github.io/reterte
title: Iniciar Sesión - Davivienda
reasons: The page impersonates Davivienda, a real bank, with a login form titled 'Iniciar Sesión - Davivienda' and fields for 'Usuario' and 'Contraseña'.
JavaScript on the page sends the entered username and password to the Telegram bot API endpoint `https://api.telegram.org/bot${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage`.
The bot token `8942080920:AAEoZFZTjv5xDwZ7dKNDkVqLnErV782gp48` and chat ID `8482091341` are hardcoded in the page source, confirming exfiltration to an attacker-controlled channel.

label: free2022kan-coder.github.io/aaaaaa
reasons: The page exfiltrates visitor data to a Discord webhook URL explicitly present in the source: 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1539758793301164034/...'
Functions like 'getAutofill' and 'getCredentials' collect sensitive visitor information including passwords, emails, and browser credentials without consent.
The code includes a keylogger ('document.addEventListener("keydown")') that captures keystrokes and sends them to the operator-controlled endpoint.
